meaning:
προ-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: for חָשַׁק, etc. ;]
to bring forth or forward. Most frequently in mid., to take by choice, prefer, propose: 2Co.9:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
